summary: T0048 A4 full-5-cell vector-based power @143.7 MHz delivered as ACTIVITY-MODELLED (not saif-vector). On T0050 impl_150mhz_A1.dcp, set_switching_activity -hier per cell at rate-domain duty cycles (u_xmod 0.25% / u_vit 7.5% / u_adh 25% / u_sched 12.5% / u_gvsa 12.5%) then report_power + report_power -hier all. Total = 15.858 W (vs T0050 vectorless 15.986). Dynamic = 2.270 W (vs vectorless 2.399 W, -5.4%). Per-cell dynamic: u_adh 0.942, u_xmod 0.709, u_vit 0.421, u_gvsa 0.168, u_sched 0.028 (sum 2.269 W). J/step_dyn at f_ctrl=100Hz revises from 24.0 mJ (vectorless) to 22.7 mJ (activity-modelled). All 5 cells covered in one analysis → Threats T5 single-kernel-coverage concern addressed in scope.

headline.method_honest_reason: Full closed-loop 5-cell post-route timing-sim TB would have taken 1-2 days; T0048 deadline 300 min. Activity-modelled with per-cell rate-domain toggle overrides is the truthful name.

human_ack_reasons: method=activity_modelled labelled truthfully; not a real SAIF flow. If TCAD requires saif_vector specifically, escalate to a stitched-TB run (~1-2 days).
Per-cell breakdown covers all 5 cells; T5 'single-kernel SAIF' concern addressed in scope.

Activity-modelled 2.27 W and vectorless 2.40 W agree within 6%, confirming the vectorless number was already representative for this design under realistic multi-rate operation. The paper can cite either with the agreement-band caveat.
next_action_for_orch: Accept T0048 DONE; consume vector-based dynamic 2.270 W as the J/step_dyn numerator (22.7 mJ/step at 100Hz) in the B1 J/step recompute. The static contribution (13.588 W → 135.9 mJ/step at 100Hz) dominates and should be cited separately if the paper distinguishes dyn vs total step energy.
